method: Owner-signed fast-forward main, matching Validate content CI, exact ZIP/runtime equality.
reviewIdentity: Claude claude-opus-5.5 and GPT gpt-6.1-sol; both CONFIRMED reviewed snapshot e5c945d6; four serial runs, one fix commit; the closure c1137b93 fast-forwards origin/main 45de81cd without a merge
limits: Textual review only: no Kotlin, Android JVM, native, rendered-font, device or phone acceptance (no JDK on the continuation machine).

8 latent reading collisions (attested readings offered by other cards) are not drawable in the checked N1, All and Starter pools: 隠 お (小 御 男 緒; KANJIDIC2 name reading), 隠 なまる (鈍), 雄 かつ (割 括 活), 雄 ゆ (愉 油 由 輸 遊), 雄 よう (eighteen holders, such as 容 and 様), 飼 かい (貝), 飽 あき (秋 空) and 飾 しか (然 鹿); all but 隠 なまる, which comes from the --extra list, are KANJIDIC2 name readings.

Three KANJIDIC2 name-only readings can be offered as wrong reading options only in a Starter practice session that also borrows a card holding them: 雄 ゆ (by 愉 or 輸), 雄 よう (by any of its eighteen holders, such as 容 or 様) and 飼 かい (by 貝); in the N1 and All pools the curated options of 雄 and 飼 fill every wrong slot.
3 lint warnings (no Dictionary: line on the word articles 隣, 眼鏡 and 鏡) are pre-existing and out of scope.

Under the batch rule, readings with no declaring word article are listed but not quizzed. Five cards quiz only their on reading (随 ズイ, 雄 ユウ, 項 コウ, 顕 ケン, 鮮 セン) and ten only their kun reading (隠 かく.す, 隣 となり, 雷 かみなり, 霧 きり, 飼 か.う, 飽 あ.きる, 飾 かざ.る, 驚 おどろ.く, 鬼 おに, 黙 だま.る).

隠れる, 飽くまで, 飾り and 驚かす use the readings かく.れる, あ.く, かざ.り and おどろ.かす, which share a stem with the quizzed かく.す, あ.きる, かざ.る and おどろ.く; the app asks one question per stem, so these articles are linked on their own rows, which are not quizzed.
Some readings on the cards rest on a single dictionary entry or a Kanjipedia-only entry and are labelled as source-only where they appear; the card text is the authority for which.

Some titles share an English word with existing titles in another sense and are not excluded from each other's quiz options, except where a Notes bullet on the card says otherwise. No two new cards exclude each other, and every exclusion between a new and an existing card is declared on the new card; the app's QuizBuilder applies an exclusion in both directions.
Each mnemonic is a modern-shape memory aid, labelled on the card as not etymology; component and stroke statements follow the pinned KanjiVG revision.
The reading audits are the author's Python ports of the Kotlin builder; no Kotlin cross-check was run.
The scope audits do not attribute reads made through shell commands or Python, so they can list files as unread that the reports say were read.
Several judgments rest partly on live reads of Kanjipedia, Digital Daijisen, Jisho and kanjiapi.dev pages, not on pinned copies in the packet.

The confirmation reviewers did not re-run the audits; they judged the check outputs that the author ran on the revised snapshot and included in their packets. confirm-gpt read the eight unchanged cards in full from the original packet; confirm-claude did not reopen them beyond their quiz options.
This exact published runtime and ZIP are verified, not the remaining N1 set.
A later contributor-only receipt commit needs its own CI and exported-tree equality check.
